sections.title: The letter cu
paragraphs: The letter is called (cu) /ku/. It has one sound. You hear it in the word (quando) /ˈkwan.do/, which means when.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air for a moment. Then let the air burst out. The voice is off. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always comes before another letter. You hear it in (questo) /ˈkwes.to/ and in (quadro) /ˈkwa.dro/. It always makes the same sound.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not let out a strong puff of air. Keep the sound sharp, like the k in skate instead of key.
